tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] React PWA & Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) ...
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my interest in this opportunity to contribute my backend and e-commerce expertise to your team. With over 5 years of professional experience building and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical skills in Java, Spring, and RESTful web services.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built RESTful APIs for headless commerce integrations and Progressive Web Application frontends.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Backends
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: System Integration
bullets.text: Built and optimized data pipelines using Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Deployment & Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal within agile DevOps workflows.

cover_en.gap: While my primary e-commerce background is rooted in SAP Commerce Cloud rather than Salesforce Commerce Cloud, and my frontend experience centers on API integrations rather than React, I am keen to leverage my strong Java and enterprise e-commerce foundations to quickly learn and adapt to your tech stack.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, allowing me to start from 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your needs.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend development experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell to your team. Having built and supported large-scale platforms using Java, Spring, and RESTful APIs, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your digital commerce initiatives.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce backend expertise, Java, Spring, and API integration skills to build scalable digital platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an experienced e-commerce and backend developer with 5+ years of expertise in Java, Spring, and REST APIs across enterprise platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid work permit, and am available from 16.12.2026. I would love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: [Post] React PWA & Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) ... - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the [Post] React PWA & Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) ... position. With over 5 years of professional experience in enterprise e-commerce, Java, Spring, and RESTful APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute to your engineering team. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and can start from 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
